title: Payment provider
description: A company a merchant signs a contract with to accept payments. One file per provider: data/providers/<id>.yaml. Facts only: no marketing copy, rankings, prices or fees.

id.description: Lowercase slug, unique in the registry, equal to the file name.

roles.description: Every role the company plays; each value is defined in GLOSSARY.md.

merchant_countries.description: Where a merchant's business can be registered to sign up. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Only with a public source.

maintainers.description: GitHub usernames of the provider's own staff who keep this file up to date.

coverage.description: The payment methods the provider supports: one entry per method, sorted by method id.

method.description: The id of a file in data/methods/.

global.description: The source says worldwide. Used instead of `countries`.

countries.description: Payer countries the provider supports this method in, as the source states. Left out when the source names none.

currencies.description: Currencies the provider processes this method in. ISO 4217.

source.description: A public page that shows this.

source_type.description: provider_docs: read from the provider's public pages. self_reported: stated by the provider in a pull request. third_party: any other public source.

checked.description: The day the source was last read. YYYY-MM-DD.
